regulation_clause.text: If a card is unused for more than one year, initiate closure after intimating the cardholder; if no reply within 30 days, close the account (subject to dues) and update the CIC within 30 days.

gold.gold_rationale: Clause 20 requires initiating closure after a card is unused for more than one year, with a 30-day cardholder reply window and a 30-day CIC update window. CBTRN02C is the daily transaction-posting batch job; its full validation path (1500-VALIDATE-TRAN calling only 1500-A-LOOKUP-XREF and 1500-B-LOOKUP-ACCT, which check card lookup, credit limit, and expiration only) contains no inactivity, last-activity-date, intimation, or closure-initiation logic anywhere. The paragraph's own comment '* ADD MORE VALIDATIONS HERE' (line 377) marks the natural insertion point for such a check.

gold.gold_rationale: Clause 23(6) requires interest be levied only on the outstanding amount, adjusted for payments, refunds, and reversed transactions. CBACT04C's 1300-COMPUTE-INTEREST computes interest directly from TRAN-CAT-BAL (lines 464-466). Per adjudication cross-reference to CBTRN02C (the program maintaining TCATBAL-FILE), TRAN-CAT-BAL is accumulated via signed ADD DALYTRAN-AMT (2700-B-UPDATE-TCATBAL-REC, line 527), and DALYTRAN-AMT is confirmed signed by the adjacent IF DALYTRAN-AMT >= 0 branch in 2800-UPDATE-ACCOUNT-REC (line 548). Signed accumulation nets offsetting payment/refund/reversal entries into the category balance by construction, satisfying the clause's adjustment requirement.

Signed accumulation means TRAN-CAT-BAL already reflects netting of offsetting entries by construction, before CBACT04C ever reads it. This is decisive primary evidence within the same bundle, not external or historical evidence, so the needs_adjudication gap is resolved rather than defaulted to exclude.
